expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Returns the current world tick delta in seconds. Returns whether world startup is in progress. Returns whether world teardown is in progress. Returns the game instance associated with this world. Returns the persistent level script actor. Returns the world persistent level. Returns this level script actor. Returns whether the level is visible. Returns whether the level is being removed from its world. Returns the level actor array; entries may be null.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Use the returned reference in a follow-up mutation or identity check to prove aliasing. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: float32 UWorld.GetDeltaSeconds() const; | bool UWorld.IsStartingUp() const; | bool UWorld.IsTearingDown() const; | UGameInstance UWorld.GetGameInstance() const; | ALevelScriptActor UWorld.GetLevelScriptActor() const; | ULevel UWorld.GetPersistentLevel() const; | ALevelScriptActor ULevel.GetLevelScriptActor() const; | bool ULevel.IsVisible() const; | bool ULevel.IsBeingRemoved() const; | const TArray<AActor>& ULevel.GetActors() const;
